messages:
Alex (CS): quick weekly pulse for MapleHealth — sharing top-line from the last 7d and QoQ trends. plz skim, callouts below. :wave:

Alex (CS): tokens WoW -3% (120M -> 116M), QoQ +14% (Q1 104M -> Q2 119M). throughput avg 180 req/s peak 420 req/s on Tue 14:00 UTC.

Maria (CS Manager): nice — any big bursts driving spend?

Alex (CS): spike on Tue was a concurrent batch job from their ingestion pipeline (MapleHealth ETL window). cost blip ~+6% that day. overall spend QoQ +8% driven by seq length increase on summaries.

Taylor (Solutions): we recommended prefix trimming and short-circuit for empty contexts. Did they try the KV cache suggestion?

Sanjay (MapleHealth): they replied in the account thread — started KV cache on Wed, helped 90% of calls with identical prompts. still seeing some long-chat sessions causing tokens.

Alex (CS): latency notes: p50 stable ~140ms, p95 moved from 420ms -> 860ms during the Tue region failover. error rate baseline 0.12% -> transient spike at 1.8% during failover, back to 0.21% now. overall small but worth flagging.

usage-bot: automated report attached: daily_tokens.csv (s3://redwood-exports/maplehealth/daily_tokens.csv) :file_folder:

Maria (CS Manager): action items: 1) run enablement on caching best-practices w/ Taylor this week, 2) set a canary for the nightly ETL window to throttle burst to avoid capacity spikes, 3) we should propose an adjusted reserved capacity plan if growth continues.

Taylor (Solutions): proposed playbook snippet to reduce burst cost:```bash
# throttle ETL concurrent workers during 13:30-15:30 UTC
for w in $(seq 1 $WORKERS); do
  if [[ $(date +%H) -ge 13 && $(date +%H) -le 15 ]]; then
    sleep $((RANDOM % 6))
  fi
done
```

Alex (CS): scheduling enablement session Thu 16:00 UTC — sending calendar invite to Sanjay and their eng lead.

Sanjay (MapleHealth): confirmed for Thu. also asked to see an itemized spend breakdown per route — can we surface that before the call?

Alex (CS): will export per-route cost table and drop in the account thread by EOD today. quick nudge: renewal health currently GREEN but growth + burst pattern is a medium risk if costs stay uncontrolled. recommend check-in in 2 weeks post enablement. :seedling:
